Package org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker

Class TerminalCardType

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker.TerminalCardType
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardTypeHandler
public final class TerminalCardType extends Object implements CardTypeHandler
The built-in terminal card type: validates a {contractVersion:'1', terminal:{...}} body through TerminalDef and emits {terminal: ...}. id= is required and src=/template= are rejected by <@card> itself before this handler runs.
Example:

<@card type="terminal" id="build">{ contractVersion: '1', terminal: { bytesUrl: '/runs/juneau-terminal/r42/bytes' } }</@card>

Since:
10.0.0

    • acceptedRoles

      public Set<String> acceptedRoles()
      The roles a terminal card may subscribe with: input-status, the answer to a term.input frame, and nudge, the server's notice that a terminal's bytes have grown.

      This set must match the roles on the terminal card handler in juneau-terminal.js, so the build-time and browser role checks agree.

      Specified by:
      acceptedRoles in interface CardTypeHandler
      Returns:
      Set.of("input-status", "nudge").
